mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 50 degrees near the Verona Area High School. Keep an eye on the sky this evening, as the International Space Station will be passing overhead starting at 5:03 PM; you can see it rise in the northwest near the high school and travel across the sky toward Fitchburg.
City Hall reminds residents that the 2027 municipal candidate packets are available for the upcoming election, and property tax bills will be hitting mailboxes by December 15.
Today is a great day for local events, featuring The Crafty Fair at ART House 360, plus live music performances at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's.
Regarding local safety, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an arrest for O W I.
You can grab a scoop of today's delicious Mint Cookie flavor at Culver's, as they are open and ready to serve you until 10:30 PM.
